logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the copper(II) complex was determined by the shake flask method from its partition in an octanol-water mixture. Calibration curves (using absorbance at 274 nm) of the copper(II) complex were used to determine both concentration of copper(II) complexes in aqueous layer before partition (C0) and concentration in aqueous layer after partition (Caq), and the Log P value (P, partition coefficient) was then calculated using Log P equation (Equation (1)). (1) Lipophilicity = Log P = Log ( Co - Caq ) Caq
